explanation: Heavy masses 17.1 and 18.3 with high G=4.725 approach to 1.44 distance at step 9. Kinetic jumps 682->800 and potential -899->-1017 in one step with only 11 substeps. Leapfrog integration loses pairwise antisymmetry under large accelerations, causing net momentum gain 0.309 (allowed 0.211) and simultaneous angular momentum violation. Lowering G to 1.0 removes the strong encounter and the violation disappears.
vision_note: Steps 6 to 9 show two large bodies at the top moving toward a very close encounter, while a small third body stays distant on the left. At step 9 the pair is at its closest separation, which matches the reported time of the momentum_conserved violation with no external walls or controllers visible.
